overlap_scope: All new-component pairs, including same rigid body and remote cradle hardware; legacy-only pairs excluded. Only own motor/visual rotor and listed own pilot-hole/thread-envelope pairs exempt. Field name retained for review compatibility.
limitations: Only neutral pose; no continuous swept collision proof
Eight palm motor-to-cradle and cradle-to-adapter fasteners modeled; adapter-to-chassis supports absent
Cable route solids are envelopes only, excluded from clash and mass checks
Thumb moving motor fasteners, tendon attachments and tensioners not detailed
Thread geometry, torque, fit, stiffness and practical tool access remain unvalidated
